steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: Your Shop
steps.body:
I'm Pemberton, your shop assistant. You run this place — I handle the shelves and the customers.

The town's crafters make the goods: the Blacksmith, Huntsman, Enchanter, Alchemist, and Chef. Tell me where to go and I'll pick up what they've got.

steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: Stocking the Shelves
steps.body:
Tell me which crafters to visit and how many items to grab from each. What's available depends on what recipes they've unlocked — the more recipes a crafter knows, the wider my selection.

If you're after something specific, place a craft request directly with the crafter. Costs more — they charge a premium for custom jobs — but you'll get exactly what you ask for.

steps.speaker: Pemberton
steps.title: Restocking
steps.body:
Don't like what I brought back? Send me out again with a Refresh — costs a bit of gold, and I can only make so many trips based on how upgraded the shop is.

Or hit Re-allocate to change which crafters I visit entirely. Either way, I'll bring back a fresh batch.
